questions.stem: What is the function of control rods in a nuclear reactor?

options.text: To transfer heat to the coolant
To absorb neutrons and control the rate of the chain reaction

questions.explanation: Control rods are made of materials that absorb neutrons (such as boron or cadmium). By raising or lowering the control rods into the reactor core, operators can control how many neutrons are available to cause further fission, thereby controlling the rate of the chain reaction and the power output.
